description: Chair Greyeyes presented SPS budget to City Council.
Chair attended Muskeg Lake Cree Nation signing ceremony.
Police Chief reported on diverse new hires.
Police Chief detailed community engagement initiatives.

chips.text: SPS reported 8 diverse ethnic groups among new recruits and provided gifts to 31 foster children.
SPS secured funding to host another 'rounddowns' community event on January 31st.

description: Police plan same service for 210 Pacific Avenue shelter.
New 210 Pacific Avenue shelter opens early to mid-spring.
It will house 35-40 individuals, less than Fairhaven.

chips.text: Chief explained police already provide similar services to Fairhaven shelter.
Services aim to support marginalized and unhoused individuals.
Police committed to building relationship with new 210 Pacific Avenue service provider.

description: Saskatoon Police reduce simple drug possession charges.
Officers now refer individuals to community programs.
SPS will track warnings and referrals from 2025.

chips.text: Commissioner asked for data on the effectiveness of community referral programs.
STC Tribal Council's drug awareness program is open to all individuals.
The percentage of simple possession charges stayed by federal prosecutors is unknown.

description: Mayor Block appointed acting Police Board Chair until January 23, 2025.

speakers.name: Board Secretary Walter
speakers.summary: Board Secretary Walter presented the report.
said: Report seeks approval to appoint Commissioner Block as acting chair.
Appointment is from January 1st to January 23rd, 2025.
This is standard procedure, following policy section 16.
